B2LT.source: Byte-identical Exp18e momentum-bias matrix, independently re-audited

accounting: Exp18 GDP whole fixed-epoch matrix mechanism; no sampling amplification
eps_definition: optimizer stability coefficient, NOT privacy epsilon
evaluation: Internal validation only, every epoch; official validation never loaded
gpu: Exactly three selected UUIDs; dynamic memory admission; <=2 workers each; <=6 total; no DDP
optimizer: Exact exp18.optimizer.Update for Adam/Momentum/STP-Ex2, beta1=.9, beta2=.999, weight_decay=0
participation: Same per-seed Exp16e permutation repeated five epochs
privacy_scope: Per-training epsilon=8,delta=1e-5; combined search/review is NOT epsilon=8; no sampling amplification
smoke: Six methods, seed 20261111, 3 steps, batch 1000, length128, internal validation64; separate directories

stability.baseline_unavailable: absolute accuracy .55 and loss 1.0 thresholds only if no baseline trial succeeds
stability.censored: never invent an unobserved stable/unstable endpoint
stability.nonmonotonic: any unstable-to-stable return triggers local densification
stability.numerical: NaN/Inf loss, clipping norm, noisy gradient, alpha, optimizer state or model parameter; terminal numerical_failure
stability.predictive: finite but final mean accuracy < baseline - .05 OR mean loss > max(1.0,1.5*baseline loss)

statistics: seed is observational unit; ddof=1 sample SD and Student-t 95% CI; paired method differences
stpex2: d0=1; scale by previous completed d; adaptive alpha, 24 bisections, 1e-6 backoff; no final denominator
stpex2_parameters: Shared triplet frozen ONLY after five fresh review seeds
